ck_area_period.name: ck_area_period
ck_area_period.value: "area"."default_period_end" IS NULL OR "area"."default_period_start" IS NULL OR "area"."default_period_end" >= "area"."default_period_start"

ck_req_period_order.name: ck_req_period_order
ck_req_period_order.value: "requirement"."period_end" IS NULL OR "requirement"."period_start" IS NULL OR "requirement"."period_end" >= "requirement"."period_start"

ck_req_denominator.name: ck_req_denominator
ck_req_denominator.value:
("requirement"."periodicity" IN ('monthly','quarterly','annual','date_range','permanent') AND "requirement"."period_start" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("requirement"."periodicity" NOT IN ('monthly','quarterly','annual','date_range','permanent') AND "requirement"."denominator_basis" IS NOT NULL)

ck_req_enumeration.name: ck_req_enumeration
ck_req_enumeration.value: "requirement"."denominator_basis" IS DISTINCT FROM 'progressive' OR "requirement"."enumeration_status" IS NOT NULL

ck_req_enum_closed.name: ck_req_enum_closed
ck_req_enum_closed.value: "requirement"."enumeration_status" <> 'closed' OR ("requirement"."enumeration_closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "requirement"."enumeration_closed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
